name: Royal Sonesta Kaua'i Resort Lihue
positioning: The Royal Sonesta Kaua'i Resort Lihue, a family-friendly beach resort on Kalapaki Beach with direct beach access and the largest one-level pool in Hawaii
best_for: Families who want calm-water swimming on Kalapaki Beach
Travelers who want an easy airport transfer with a complimentary round-the-clock shuttle
Guests interested in Hawaiian cultural activities and a weekly oceanfront luau

facts.text: The resort offers guests direct access to Kalapaki Beach, whose calm waters are protected by a cove and suit swimming and light water sports.
The resort is family-friendly and located on Kalapaki Beach.
All resort guests can use the complimentary Lihue Airport shuttle around the clock.
Rooms feature refined decor, custom hardwood finishes and fine furnishings.
Guests can lounge on cabanas or daybeds on the beach.
The resort fee includes Hawaiian cultural activities such as lei making, ukulele and hula lessons.
Nearby Wailua Falls is easily accessible, unlike other Kauai waterfalls that require a challenging hike.
Cafe Portofino serves Northern Italian cuisine with ocean views and was founded in 1989.
Duke's Kauai has a laid-back barefoot bar serving tropical cocktails and classic island dishes.

highlights.text: The resort has the largest one-level pool in Hawaii.
The resort hosts a weekly oceanfront luau, Drums & Dances of Polynesia, on Kalapaki Bay with a backdrop of mountains and ocean.
Guest rooms have balconies or verandas with views of the ocean, gardens or pool.
The Alexander Day Spa and Salon offers beachside spa treatments, including beach massages, facials and body treatments.
The Ocean Course at Hokuala, less than a mile from the resort, has the longest oceanfront golf stretch in Hawaii.

considerations.text: Room rates are subject to a daily resort fee plus taxes.
As Kaua'i recovers from Hurricane Lowell, access to some beaches, attractions and excursions may be limited.
Guests must be 21 or over to check in.
